info.name: Storyblok Content Delivery API v2 Assets Datasources API

params.name: token
params.description: The API access token for the space. Use the public token to access published content or the preview token to access draft content.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results. Starts at 1. Requesting a page higher than the last available page returns an empty array.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return per page. Maximum is 100 for most endpoints.

params.name: search
params.description: Filter datasources by name using a partial text match.

items.docs: Returns a list of all datasources defined in the space. Datasources are reusable collections of key-value pairs used for options lists, translations, and configuration. Use this endpoint to discover available datasources before fetching their entries.

params.name: token
params.description: The API access token for the space. Use the public token to access published content or the preview token to access draft content.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results. Starts at 1. Requesting a page higher than the last available page returns an empty array.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of items to return per page. Maximum is 100 for most endpoints.

params.name: datasource
params.description: The slug of the datasource to retrieve entries from.

params.name: datasource_id
params.description: The numeric ID of the datasource to retrieve entries from.

params.name: dimension
params.description: Dimension slug to retrieve dimension-specific values alongside the default values.

params.name: cv
params.description: Cache version timestamp to bypass CDN caching.

items.docs: Returns the key-value entries for a specific datasource. Optionally filter by dimension to retrieve locale-specific or variant values. Results are paginated and can be filtered by datasource slug or ID.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100.

items.docs: Returns all datasources defined in the space. Use this endpoint to enumerate available datasources before creating, updating, or deleting their entries.

params.name: space_id
params.description: Numeric ID of the Storyblok space.

items.docs: Creates a new datasource in the space. Optionally define dimensions to support locale-specific or variant values alongside the default entries.
